content.short: SubQuery is a leading decentralized blockchain data indexer providing fast, flexible, and open APIs for Web3 projects building on Mantle.
content.description: SubQuery is an open-source and decentralized data indexing framework that empowers developers to build custom GraphQL APIs for any blockchain data. By defining what data to index and query, teams avoid the overhead of building and maintaining complex indexing infrastructure from scratch. SubQuery's decentralized network of indexers ensures data availability and uptime, while its open-source framework guarantees transparency. SubQuery fully supports Mantle Network and provides comprehensive indexing tooling for Mantle dApp developers.
